events.title: External Project Memory bridge must work without manual repetition
events.summary: Project outcomes produced outside SG must cross a trusted repository-backed structured handoff into the existing Project Memory automatically.
events.rationale: The Monarch requires automatic project memory and must not repeat a separate remember command after development work.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory handoff had no live ingress
events.summary: The deployed hook listened for sg_project_handoff, but the tool was not registered and the green contract test injected a synthetic tool result.

events.title: Repair the automatic external Project Memory bridge
events.summary: Register and validate the live handoff tool, ingest canonical repository handoffs before project answers, and prove the real tool-to-hook-to-Memory-Core chain.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory bridge committed
events.summary: The registered handoff tool, canonical GitHub bridge, automatic pre-answer synchronization, source validation, deduplication and secret filtering were committed.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory implementation passed CI
events.summary: GitHub Actions run 301 completed successfully for the functional implementation commit.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory image pinned
events.summary: Dockerfile.render was pinned to the verified functional image and the branch remote HEAD advanced to the pin commit.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory pin passed CI
events.summary: GitHub Actions run 302 completed successfully for the image pin commit.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory bridge deployed live
events.summary: Render deploy dep-damd252d0e5s73evhlng became live with image 4d3c2fba6d336d413eccc8dff8f14733fb9c6382; health returned 200, gateway became ready, Telegram polling started and no post-deploy errors were present.

events.title: Automatic external Project Memory bridge completed
events.summary: The implementation, CI, image pin and verified live deployment are complete.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory ingress repaired
events.summary: The missing live ingress was repaired and verified through commit, CI, deployment health, gateway readiness and Telegram polling.

events.title: Project Memory lifecycle must be fully automatic
events.summary: Project decisions, task changes and incidents must be handed off during the project-changing run, while commits, Actions and Render deploy outcomes must be reconciled directly from authoritative services without a later memory-only commit.
events.rationale: The Monarch explicitly requires Project Memory to remain complete without a separate remember request or manual post-deploy closeout.

events.title: Project lifecycle closeout still required a manual handoff
events.summary: The repository handoff consumer worked, but commit, Actions and deploy outcomes were appended later by a separate manual metadata change.

events.title: Implement the automatic Project Memory producer
events.summary: Add authoritative lifecycle reconciliation, semantic handoff enforcement for SG and Codex, failure incident capture, startup recovery and replay-safe deduplication.

events.title: Automatic Project Memory producer implemented
events.summary: SG now reconciles GitHub commits, completed or failed Actions and live or failed Render deploys automatically; project-changing SG and Codex runs cannot finish without a new semantic handoff; repeat ingestion remains idempotent.

events.title: Manual Project Memory lifecycle closeout removed
events.summary: The functional change contains its semantic handoff, and subsequent commit, CI and deploy evidence will be discovered automatically without another handoff-only commit.
